summary: Multi-sponsor architecture regression: 11/13 backend pytest pass. Two spec-deviation failures found (auto-demote managing on PATCH, and /client/me primary-client exemption ignoring sponsor scoping). Frontend Package + Documents tabs verified visually: 3 sponsor cards with Managing/Guarantor chips, Add Sponsor works, 'Viewing docs for' filter dropdown present, Fee Agreement card shows sponsor dropdown + per-sponsor fee_agreements list with SENT/SUPERSEDED chips. Lender view returns sanitized sponsors[] (no client_user_id leak). Backward-compat scenario (legacy body.sponsor) correctly migrates to sponsors[0] with role=managing + client_user_id=scen.client_id. Fee-agreement send-to-Bob (unlinked) correctly returns 400.

minor.issue: Spec says only one 'managing' sponsor per deal. When caller sends sponsors[] with two sponsors both role='managing' (e.g. promoting Bob without demoting Alice), backend does NOT auto-demote the prior managing. Current logic at server.py:2055-2064 only checks 'has_managing' (>=1) and never enforces uniqueness. Result: both remain 'managing'. Fix: after normalization, if >1 managing, keep the newly-promoted one and demote the rest to 'guarantor' (or the earliest one and warn caller).

Spec: 'user sees only shared docs + docs scoped to sponsors they're linked to'. Current code at server.py:1199-1201 has `is_primary` exemption: if user is scen.client_id (primary client), they see ALL docs regardless of sponsor_id. In the tested case sample@example.com is both primary client_id AND Alice's sponsor.client_user_id, so PATCHing a doc to Bob's sponsor_id still shows it in the borrower view. This is a security/scoping bug — a docket auto-tagged to Bob (a different sponsor) leaks to Alice. Fix: drop the `is_primary` exemption OR only apply it when the user is primary client and NOT linked to any sponsor on that scenario.

issues: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears somewhere in a <select>. Non-blocking but flag to fix (search for JSX rendering a span inside <option>).

action_items: Fix PATCH /admin/scenarios/{sid} to enforce single managing sponsor (auto-demote prior managing when a different one is promoted).
Fix /api/client/me: remove or narrow the `is_primary` exemption so docs scoped to a sponsor the user is NOT linked to are hidden — even when the user is the primary client_id.
Investigate React hydration warning: <span> child inside <option> in admin scenario detail.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2055-2064 PATCH sponsors: uniqueness of role='managing' not enforced. Multiple managing roles can coexist after PATCH. Recommend explicit demotion step.

server.py:1194-1211 /client/me: `is_primary` exemption defeats sponsor-scoping filter for the primary client. Since a scenario's primary client_id is often also linked as a sponsor, this exemption is redundant and introduces a leak path.
server.py is still 7248 lines — carry-forward from iter 8. Consider modular split.

In POST /admin/scenarios, personal-category auto-tagging heuristic uses substring matches ('PFS', 'Tax Return') on English labels. Consider a robust `is_personal` template flag on each item to avoid future breakage if labels are localized/renamed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical multi-sponsor UI flows verified
